name: NextPDF
title: NextPDF — Free browser PDF editor
description: Edit PDFs in your browser. Replace text, highlight, draw, sign, and download. The file stays on your device and is never uploaded.
headline: Edit PDFs in your browser
lead: Drop a file here, or browse from this computer.

features.title: Replace text
features.body: Drag across words or lines and type the replacement. This works when the page already has a text layer. A scanned page does not.

features.title: Highlight, draw, and images
features.body: Mark a passage, sketch on the page, or place a PNG or JPEG.

features.title: Sign and cut
features.body: Draw a signature and place it on the page, or cut a rectangular or circular region out of the page.

features.title: Pages
features.body: Rotate or delete pages, move through the document, and zoom in on a detail.

features.title: Private by default
features.body: The file stays in this browser tab. Nothing is uploaded to a server.

features.title: Download
features.body: Undo and redo as you work, then download the edited PDF. New text uses Helvetica, Times, or Courier.

limits: The file stays in this browser. Nothing is uploaded.
Drag across a few words or several lines to replace them. A scanned page has no text layer.
Very large PDFs can run out of memory in the tab.
